description: This PHP file defines the SuiteCRMInternalCalendarProvider class, which implements an internal calendar provider for SuiteCRM. It handles operations such as testing connections, fetching, creating, updating, and deleting calendar events (meetings, calls, tasks) within the SuiteCRM environment, using database beans and internal logic.

classes.name: SuiteCRMInternalCalendarProvider
classes.description: Implements an internal calendar provider for SuiteCRM, managing calendar events through database beans and internal logic.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to the internal calendar by instantiating a Meetings bean.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events (meetings, calls, tasks) based on the provided query.

methods.name: getMeetings
methods.description: Fetches a list of meetings for a specific user based on the query parameters.

methods.name: buildBaseWhereConditions
methods.description: Constructs base SQL WHERE conditions to filter records by assigned user and deletion status.

methods.name: buildDateConditions
methods.description: Adds date range filters to SQL WHERE conditions based on query parameters.

methods.name: getCalls
methods.description: Fetches call events for a user based on query filters.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Fetches task events for a user, excluding completed tasks.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event (meeting) in SuiteCRM based on the provided CalendarAccountEvent.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event identified by the target event ID.

methods.name: findEventBean
methods.description: Finds and returns the bean and type of an event based on the target ID, searching in meetings, calls, and tasks.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event with the specified target ID from SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a calendar event by its target ID, returning a CalendarAccountEvent if found and active.

methods.name: getEventFromBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent from a bean (meeting, call, or task) based on the event type.
